content:
Last week saw discount promotions across multiple current Apple products, from 25% off the AirPods Pro 3 to $120 off the latest AirPods Max 2, with deals continuing to roll in. While the above offers are still valid, Amazon has just set an all-time low price for the Apple 2026 AirTag 2, with a single unit going for as low as $20.

During last week's anniversary sales, we reported that the AirTag 2 had hit several historical low prices; if you missed out, don't worry—the price has just dropped to a new low, the best we've ever recorded.

Amazon is still selling a single AirTag 2 for $24, matching the best price we've seen since the product launched; but the 4-pack has now dropped to $79.99 with free shipping.

Apple's official 4-pack is priced at $99, with each unit already averaging less than the regular single-unit price of $29; now with nearly 20% off, it's not just a historical low—each AirTag 2 is just $20.

The previous $90 deal on the 4-pack may well continue throughout the week as various retailers run their anniversary sales; but whether Amazon's all-time low lasts is another story, as prices could go up at any time.

We've previously covered the differences between the original AirTag and this year's upgraded AirTag 2—check out our earlier piece for full details, but here are the highlights:

  • Precision Finding range is 1.5 times farther than the previous generation
  • Volume is 50% louder than the previous generation
  • The AirTag 2's built-in speaker can be heard from up to twice the distance
  • Offers 'an industry-first, comprehensive set of unwanted tracking protections'

New AirTag 2 features are coming soon

AirTag 2 drops to $20 each, coinciding with the upcoming launch of iOS 27 and watchOS 27 next month. For Apple Watch users, there's even better news: the Find My app now supports Precision Finding, meaning you can now use your Apple Watch—with on-screen arrows and specific distance info—to locate your AirTag.

watchOS 27 also unifies the Find My experience within a single app. Previously, the Find My experience on Apple Watch was split across three separate app icons: People, Items, and Devices.

As for iOS 27, it brings a brand new design and interface refinements to the Find My app, making it easier to track both people and items.

Taking all of this into account, now is the perfect time to expand your AirTag 2 collection at this price.

  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (original price $549)
  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (original price $249)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (original price $129)
